chapters.title: Build a complete fabric costing
chapters.description: Enter fabric construction, warp and weft yarns, rates, waste, weaving, overhead, margin and quantity. Review the live production cost of Rs 32.08/m and suggested price of Rs 36.45/m.

chapters.title: Change inputs and recheck live cost
chapters.description: Review pricing assumptions. Change the weft yarn rate from Rs 112 to Rs 128/kg and the target margin from 12% to 15%. The updated cost is Rs 33.23/m and the selling price is Rs 39.09/m.

chapters.title: Understand the cost breakdown
chapters.description: Switch to Detailed to inspect the yarn-consumption formulas, waste and crimp adjustments, and production-cost breakdown. Quick and Detailed use the same calculation engine.

narration.speaker: Neha
narration.description: Neha speaks at a moderate pace in a clear, calm, slightly expressive voice. The recording is very high quality, with very clear audio, no background noise and a close-sounding voice.
